subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should MiniMax Token Plan subagent support be fixed through provider-owned endpoint/auth routing, a narrow skill/plugin handoff, or a broader subagent bootstrap inheritance change?
rationale: The remaining work crosses a live external API contract and OpenClaw's deliberate subagent context boundary, so automation cannot choose the permanent product policy safely.

options.title: Provider-owned proof and routing
options.body: First prove the Token Plan image endpoint/auth behavior live, then change only the MiniMax provider path if the current dedicated endpoint is wrong for that credential type.

options.title: Narrow skill/plugin handoff
options.body: Keep the subagent bootstrap boundary and add or document a Token Plan plugin/skill mechanism if office-generation skills need subagent availability.

options.title: Broaden subagent bootstrap
options.body: Allow more workspace skill context in subagents, accepting the context-boundary and security tradeoff explicitly.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned proof and routing
recommendation.body: First prove the Token Plan image endpoint/auth behavior live, then change only the MiniMax provider path if the current dedicated endpoint is wrong for that credential type.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent maintainer-side context on both MiniMax Token Plan fixes and the Codex/subagent boundary discussion.
